en: Color-printed vintage postcard showing a formal garden with flowerbeds and a straight path leading toward a large, elegant building in the background. The structure is a French Second Empire–style mansion or palace with a mansard roof and a tall central clock tower. Trees and ornamental shrubs frame the garden, and the image has a grainy, early color-printing look with a white border.
